sections.shortTitle: Azad Jammu and Kashmir Court Fees Abolition Act 1985
sections.description:
Short titlel, extent and commencement

THE AZAD JAMMU AND KASHMIR COURT FEES
THE AZAD JAMMU AND
KASHMIR COURT FEES
(ABOLITION) ACT,
1985
(ACT XXII OF 1985)
[Dated November 27, 1985]
AN ACT to provide for the
abolition of Court fee in respect of certain cases.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
provide for the abolition of Court fee in respect of certain cases; It is
hereby enacted as follows ;
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑-----
(1) This Act may be called the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Court Fees
(Abolition) Act, 1985.
(2) It extends to the whole of Azad Jammu and Kashmir.
(3) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 4th day of
November, 1985.

sections.description:
Abolition of Court fee in certain cases

THE AZAD JAMMU AND KASHMIR COURT FEES
THE AZAD JAMMU AND
KASHMIR COURT FEES
(ABOLITION) ACT,
1985
(ACT XXII OF 1985)
[Dated November 27, 1985]
AN ACT to provide for the
abolition of Court fee in respect of certain cases.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
provide for the abolition of Court fee in respect of certain cases; It is
hereby enacted as follows ;
2. Abolition of Court fee in certain
cases.‑--- Notwithstanding anything contained in the Court Fees Act,
1870 (VII of 1870) or any other law for the time being inforce, or any rules or
orders, no court fee shall he payable in or chargeable by, any Court in respect
of:‑
(a) any criminal case; and
(b) any case of civil nature the value of
the subject matter whereof or relief claimed therein, does not exceed twenty
five thousand rupees.

Savings

THE AZAD JAMMU AND KASHMIR COURT FEES
THE AZAD JAMMU AND
KASHMIR COURT FEES
(ABOLITION) ACT,
1985
(ACT XXII OF 1985)
[Dated November 27, 1985]
AN ACT to provide for the
abolition of Court fee in respect of certain cases.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
provide for the abolition of Court fee in respect of certain cases; It is
hereby enacted as follows ;
3. Savings.‑---- Notwithstanding
any judgement, decree or order of any Court including High Court, every thing
done, all actions taken, notifications issued, orders or appointments made,
proceedings initiated, jurisdiction or powers exercised under the provisions of
the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance, 1979 (Ordinance
XXXVI of 1979) or its succeeding Ordinances issued from time to time shall be
deemed to have been validly done, taken, issued, made, initiated or exercised
under this Act.
This Act was passed by the Legislative Assembly on 4‑11‑1985
and published in the official Gazette of Azad Jammu and Kashmir dated 27‑11‑1985,
See issue No. 552 of vol. XXXI
